Tess (PM): Heads-up: new traffic projections force a hard cap for next ship. Need a cutlist and a short timeline tweak. Starter proposal: 1) MVP = chat core + embeddings read-only; 2) defer tenant SSO to v1; 3) move per-tenant analytics to v1; 4) reduce dedicated pool by 35% and rely on autoscale. Thoughts?

Noah (Eng): okay on cuts if we add a fallback model route and a rollback script. reducing pool without fallback risks long tail latency.

Rina (SRE): agree. recommend 5% canary for 48h and a 10-day timeline shift to finish fallback + tests. will add alerts for p95 > 600ms.

Evan (CS): pilots asked for SSO and analytics. If we cut them, offer manual CSV exports and a FAQ. keeps pilots running.

Hana (Design): if SSO is deferred, keep an unobtrusive banner and an email-invite flow. remove analytics from primary nav.

Tess (PM): decision draft: cut tenant SSO and per-tenant analytics from MVP; offer manual exports for pilots; reduce pool by 35% with fallback routing; shift GA by 10 days to finish fallback + run canary. Owners: Noah = rollback script + fallback, Rina = canary + alerts, Evan = pilot comms, Hana = UI updates.

Noah (Eng): I'll add a feature flag for analytics and a simple rollback script. snippet: ```sh
# rollback
./deploy rollback --to=previous
```

release-bot: Deploy window proposed: 2026-05-27 03:00 UTC — canary 5% for 48h.

Rina (SRE): I'll codify telemetry checks at 6h/24h/48h and add automated rollback if p95 > 700ms for 10m.

Evan (CS): I'll draft pilot messaging and a CSV export runbook.

Hana (Design): I'll produce a small modal + banner copy by EOD tomorrow.

Tess (PM): If no objections by EOD, I'll lock the cutlist and shift the GA by 10 days. :lock: 

Noah (Eng): +1 from eng.

Rina (SRE): +1 infra.

Evan (CS): +1.

Hana (Design): +1.

Tess (PM): locking cuts and timeline. I'll update the roadmap and ping execs after this thread.
